scope: Native integrated file audit against actual native body/armor component saves and existing-weapon source input. No Blockbench or model changes.
animation_scope: Animations may be added separately. This audit excludes animations and does not certify any motion.

material_checks.formula: max((sRGBDecode(auxiliary.rgb).b * Emissive * EmissivePower + sRGBDecode(albedo.rgb) * NaturalEmissive) * DeathEmissive, 0)

preview_scope.surface_lighting: Blockbench studio light; not original scene lighting
preview_scope.note: Only the static linear emissive equation is ported from DXBC. Preview tone mapping and scene light are explicitly separate.
preview_scope.material_limit: Original static emissive equation ported; original specular/roughness sampling and full game lighting are not represented by the Blockbench studio surface light.

material_checks.execution_limit: This file audit verifies metadata and texture association, not the running shader or full original game render.

weapon_attachment.scope: Original existing Java weapon geometry and texture; cross-game hand/socket basis is an explicit adapter, not original Dungeons armor geometry.

authorized_weapon_rigid_translation.mathematical_invariance: A common translation preserves shape, scale, orientation and pairwise distances; floating-point distance recomputation residuals are reported separately.

visual_review.view: Actual native animation.idle time 0 preview, with user-authorized dark palette 0.40.
observed: Hat brim sits above the skeleton head; green hat, silver buckle, robe sleeves and body have the expected orientation.
The spear is held upright in front of the body in the idle pose and partially occludes the face/torso.
No definite silhouette-breaking body/armor penetration was identified in this one visible view.
not_verified: The spear overlap in this single projection cannot prove or exclude actual 3D intersection.
Occluded back/side surfaces, movement poses and full-range collision clearance were not shown; no all-angle no-clipping acceptance.

limits: Component native source models already carry their own original-asset verification; this check verifies faithful assembly of those sources.
Original player versus Mossy attachment-world comparison is recorded separately; this report does not assert full animation retargeting acceptance.
File-only metadata audit does not execute the material plugin, validate game rendering, or measure motion clipping.
